verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ בָּ֔א בֹּעֵ֖ר כַּתַּנּ֑וּר וְהָי֨וּ כָל־ זֵדִ֜ים וְכָל־ עֹשֵׂ֤ה רִשְׁעָה֙ קַ֔שׁ וְלִהַ֨ט אֹתָ֜ם הַיּ֣וֹם הַבָּ֗א אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ יַעֲזֹ֥ב לָהֶ֖ם שֹׁ֥רֶשׁ וְעָנָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh hay·yō·wm bā bō·‘êr kat·tan·nūr wə·hā·yū ḵāl zê·ḏîm wə·ḵāl ‘ō·śêh riš·‘āh qaš wə·li·haṭ ’ō·ṯām hay·yō·wm hab·bā ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·šer lō- ya·‘ă·zōḇ lā·hem šō·reš wə·‘ā·nāp̄
verses.literal: For behold the day is coming burning like a furnace when all the arrogant and every evildoer . . . will be stubble the day is coming when I will set them ablaze says the LORD of Hosts Not a root or branch will be left to them
verses.literalPt: Pois eis que vem o dia e arde como fornalha; todos os soberbos e todos os que obram impiedade serão como o restolho; o dia que vem os abrasará, diz Jeová dos Exércitos, de sorte que não lhes deixará nem raiz nem ramo.

verses.original: וְזָרְחָ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יִרְאֵ֤י שְׁמִי֙ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ צְדָקָ֔ה וּמַרְפֵּ֖א בִּכְנָפֶ֑יהָ וִֽיצָאתֶ֥ם וּפִשְׁתֶּ֖ם כְּעֶגְלֵ֥י מַרְבֵּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·rə·ḥāh lā·ḵem yir·’ê šə·mî še·meš ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·mar·pê biḵ·nā·p̄e·hā wî·ṣā·ṯem ū·p̄iš·tem kə·‘eḡ·lê mar·bêq
verses.literal: But for you who fear My name the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall
verses.literalPt: Mas para vós, os que temeis o meu nome, nascerá o sol da justiça, trazendo curas nas suas asas; vós saireis e saltareis como os bezerros da estrebaria.

verses.original: וְעַסּוֹתֶ֣ם רְשָׁעִ֔ים כִּֽי־ יִהְי֣וּ אֵ֔פֶר תַּ֖חַת כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם בַּיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘as·sō·w·ṯem rə·šā·‘îm kî- yih·yū ’ê·p̄er ta·ḥaṯ kap·pō·wṯ raḡ·lê·ḵem bay·yō·wm ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then you will trample the wicked for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing says the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Pisareis os ímpios, pois serão cinza debaixo das plantas dos vossos pés no dia que eu faço, diz Jeová dos Exércitos.

verses.original: זִכְר֕וּ תּוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֑י אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹת֤וֹ בְחֹרֵב֙ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū tō·w·raṯ mō·šeh ‘aḇ·dî ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯōw ḇə·ḥō·rêḇ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl ḥuq·qîm ū·miš·pā·ṭîm
verses.literal: Remember the law of My servant Moses the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos da lei de Moisés, meu servo, a qual lhe mandei em Horebe para todo o Israel, a saber, estatutos e juízos.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ שֹׁלֵ֣חַ לָכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֵלִיָּ֣ה הַנָּבִ֑יא לִפְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·lê·aḥ lā·ḵem ’êṯ ’ê·lî·yāh han·nā·ḇî lip̄·nê bō·w yō·wm Yah·weh hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·han·nō·w·rā
verses.literal: Behold I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu vos enviarei o profeta Elias, antes que venha o grande e terrível Dia de Jeová.

verses.original: וְהֵשִׁ֤יב לֵב־ אָבוֹת֙ עַל־ בָּנִ֔ים וְלֵ֥ב בָּנִ֖ים עַל־ אֲבוֹתָ֑ם פֶּן־ אָב֕וֹא וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ חֵֽרֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·šîḇ lêḇ- ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- bā·nîm wə·lêḇ bā·nîm ‘al- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām pen- ’ā·ḇō·w wə·hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ḥê·rem
verses.literal: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the hearts of the children to their fathers Otherwise I will come and strike the land with a curse
verses.literalPt: Ele converterá o coração dos pais aos filhos e o coração dos filhos a seus pais, para que eu não venha e fira a terra com anátema.
